author: root-upload-design

checks.description: Actual authenticated fixed-helper browser upload with real signed RAUC fixture and no OS activation or ordinary-user access.
Bounded binary chunk/ack transport, metadata/output/size/time/space limits, real signature and policy refusal, truthful verification scope.
Cancellation, process loss and reconnect retain truthful managed state; reviewed exact-object cleanup refuses stale/referenced/linked objects and never replays.
Responsive status and policy during stalled transfer; ordered upload/job/state/lease exclusion under upload/discard/stage races.
Fixed installed staging and diagnostics, measured bounds, affected runtime/browser and repository consistency checks with honest evidence boundaries.

constraints.text: Dispatch only after the declared Cockpit integration dependency is independently completed, then extend its real authenticated disposable environment. Preserve fixed installed helper/policy/keyring, ordinary-user privilege rejection, existing drafts and job durability, no slot/boot/state initialization or activation, and separate offline versus hardware/release evidence.

Document and test complete lock ordering across intake, discard, Controller capability/status, Jobs.submit/work and Transaction. Brief admission may acquire ledger then state then upload; retain only upload during streaming/verification/publication and never reacquire state or ledger while holding upload. Fresh and stale image submissions during intake must refuse before creating an ambiguous durable job. Deterministically race admission on both sides, including queued/running/interrupted image work; demonstrate responsive status, history and unrelated policy writes. Retain leased stage reauthentication and all current-state/customization/idle guards.

Enforce finite server-side metadata, transfer size, chunk/window, inactivity and overall deadlines and bounded output, including RAUC verification subprocess output and duration; browser-only timeouts are insufficient. Release the lease on timeout/process termination without leaving verifier children able to access a published or discarded object. Test malformed/fragmented acknowledgements, truncated/excess input and a stalled verifier, with measured memory/storage bounds. Preserve the explicit-digest API and truthful manifest-only verification scope.

Cleanup must reauthorize the exact reviewed managed file under consistent transaction/job and upload exclusion, binding object identity and revision and refusing stale/replaced/linked/referenced or ambiguous objects. Preserve previous partials until separately reviewed, retain diagnostic/reconciliation dependencies, and clean only the current unpublished temporary file automatically. Reconnect and lost final acknowledgement must inspect actual managed state and never infer publication from acknowledged byte count or replay operations.

decision.rationale: ADR 0010 explicitly requires authenticated bounded upload, signature errors, guarded image staging and usable administration. This finishes that accepted workflow without expanding authority. Current Staging.receive has no browser transport and holds an exclusive staging lease; HostImages only lists completed digest names. Selected cockpit-bridge 337-1+deb13u2 archive hash matches the proposal; its packaged cockpit.js implements binary input, streaming and immediate-return input without a drain promise, supporting the proposed bounded acknowledgement protocol. Jobs.submit currently plans while holding ledger.lock, Controller.status obtains state, and Transaction.source_admitted uses state then upload, so the proposed brief coordinated admission and upload-only transfer requires the concurrency constraints below. sv08_bundle.inspect authenticates a RAUC manifest and explicitly returns full_payload_verified=false; its currently unbounded check_output must not defeat new transport bounds. Reviewed cleanup is necessary because receive currently refuses any existing completed or interrupted upload, and is bounded by existing preservation requirements. Approval covers offline implementation only, after host-admin-cockpit-integration:implement is done; no hardware operation, deployment, activation, account provisioning, publication or job reconciliation is authorized. Primary Cockpit process API https://docs.cockpit-project.org/cockpit-guide/main/guide/cockpit-spawn.html accessed 2026-09-12 corroborates binary streams and repeated input; selected package source is the version-specific evidence. Proposal and requirement hashes were independently computed, and the actual review-context CLI branch computed scope against the private record through a read-only path overlay; the coordinator must compare the unmodified CLI context after byte-identical public staging before importing.

evidence.limitations: Offline only. Tiny synthetic policy/images; no physical printer, A/B slot write, release/factory-capacity fit or production identity/TLS acceptance. Image stage/terminal lifecycle checks use declared unit backends; real terminal cleanup retains immutable/device validation. Browser protocol doubles and native RAUC proof are distinct from actual Cockpit/guest RAUC authentication.
evidence.method: Actual Cockpit 337/PAM/sudo in a full ARM64 QEMU guest: ordinary helper denial, browser file picker/review, 64 KiB chunk/ACK transfer, real Debian RAUC 1.13 signed manifest, private mode-0400 publication, read-only listing and unchanged state hash. Installed helper/core/UI hashes equal source. No deployable slot backend is present.

tasks.title: Implement and verify bounded authenticated bundle intake and cleanup

verification.rationale:
Independently verified the complete 25-file diff from recorded base 0bbb137 to clean HEAD 01b83b9fe8f45e487e200aa7e01df2025d6d5cd8, including new files, modes and absence of deletions/gitlink changes. All five submitted evidence rows bind that HEAD. Recomputed the complete approved decision digest, proposal/requirement digests, evidence-list digest, public evidence-document digest, 19 source hashes and ten retained execution-file hashes; the actual guest-installed core/UI hashes and retained signed-bundle digest match. The Cockpit prerequisite is present at the run base and its real full ARM64 fixture was extended.

real-upload: Inspected actual Cockpit/PAM/sudo browser test entry points, retained preparation/package/guest/browser records and corresponding public report. They exercise ordinary-user helper rejection, file selection and separate review, chunk/ACK transfer, real guest RAUC 1.13 authentication, mode-0400 publication, listing, truthful manifest-only verification and unchanged state. Installed source hashes match the delivery. The guest has no deployable slot adapter; code inspection confirms intake cannot install, arm, reboot or initialize state. This is actual authentication/signature evidence, distinct from the browser shim regressions.

bounds: Independently reproduced all five Node protocol cases, including fragmented valid ACKs, malformed/oversized/wrong-offset output and truncated UTF-8 completion; maximum slice and outstanding window are 65,536 bytes. Reproduced helper overall-deadline, verifier timeout/output, metadata/truncation and child-lifecycle tests. Independently authenticated the retained real signed fixture with the matching native RAUC binary and reproduced seven policy/signature refusals. Reviewed existing size/space/inode/checksum tests and actual low-space refusal. Server bounds include metadata, size, I/O inactivity, overall lifetime, verifier duration/output and publication/hash lifetime. Full payload verification remains explicitly deferred to installation. Storage and payload growth claims distinguish logical transport bounds from total browser RSS and image capacity.

disconnect-cleanup: Actual browser evidence covers review cancellation, upload cancellation, helper SIGKILL with retained partial, authenticated reconnect, deliberately lost final response with retained completed object, explicit cleanup and no replay. Independently reproduced exact-object/stale/replaced/link/nonmanaged/failed-reference refusal and distinct successive release stage/cancel/cleanup cycles with preserved receipts. Earlier review issues are corrected: cleanup retains ledger/state/upload exclusion through revalidation and unlink; atomic renameat2 no-replace publication avoids the two-hardlink crash window; the verifier subreaper inherits the same upload flock until its descendants are killed/reaped. The deterministic frozen-guardian SIGKILL test passes and proves parent death alone does not release exclusion.

concurrency: Independently reproduced paused transfer with responsive status/history/policy writes, second upload/removal refusal, fresh/stale stage refusal before durable receipt creation, and admission-first queued/running/interrupted job exclusion. Inspected Jobs.submit/work, Controller capabilities, Transaction admission and cleanup lock ordering. Long intake retains only upload, never reacquires ledger/state, and installed stage reauthentication retains the lease plus current-state/customization/idle guards. Terminal cleanup retains real immutable-root, running-release, device/GPT/environment and backend postconditions; the new read-only command callback is bounded without imposing a new installation timeout or granting writable cleanup bypass.

integration: Independently reproduced 36 targeted upload/lifecycle, boot, RAUC-backend and UI-staging checks; the storage subset required its intended secure-ancestry temporary directory after ignored-local placement correctly failed Staging admission. Independently tested bounded callback routing and matching-core refusal. Reviewed all supplied affected regression logs and three browser suites. Changed JSON parses, all 64 local Markdown targets resolve, both diff checks pass and all seven indexed gitlinks agree with the lock. Submodules are uninitialized in this review worktree, explicitly reported rather than represented as built.

Acceptance is offline only. The actual ARM64 guest was already stopped/deleted; I inspected its hash-bound execution evidence rather than claiming an independent rerun of its authentication session. Native RAUC negatives and targeted runtime/protocol tests were independently rerun. Stage and terminal lifecycle postconditions use declared test backends; writable intake is broader than terminal cleanup, which can require a subsequent immutable boot. A kernel-stalled verifier deliberately retains busy exclusion. No printer, physical deployment, production account/TLS identity, A/B device installation, factory-capacity fit or release compatibility is certified. No material acceptance failure remains in the submitted scope.
